By the way, hi

I'm Faith — I make AI feel human.

I'm a content creator and brand strategist working with tech and AI brands across Nigeria, the US and the UK. I script, film and edit everything myself.

My rule is simple: I only make content I've actually lived. So whether it's your product on camera or a fully AI-generated piece, it lands as real — the kind people stop for, think about, and remember.
